_PROVENANCE.STATUS: QUARANTINED — NOT A VALID HELD-OUT METRIC
_PROVENANCE.summary: The HydroViT water-quality R2 reported in this file (water_temp R2 ~= 0.893, mean R2 ~= 0.652) was computed on paired_wq_v5.npz, which contains FABRICATED targets. It is NOT a valid held-out number and must not be cited.
_PROVENANCE.fabrication_detail: paired_wq_v5.npz is produced by scripts/preprocessing/expand_hydrovit_data.py. Its seasonal_augmentation() adds U(0,8) degrees C to the water_temp TARGET and multiplies every other target by U(0.9,1.1) (+-10%). These augmented (invented) rows are included in train/val/test, so the test labels are partly fabricated.
_PROVENANCE.data_absent: Both the fabricated paired_wq_v5.npz and the REAL paired_wq_v3.npz are ABSENT from disk as of 2026-06, so this number is also unreproducible.
_PROVENANCE.required_action: needs-new-data: a real number requires rebuilding the REAL paired_wq_v3.npz from NWIS x Sentinel-2 pairs (or placing real tiles in data/processed/satellite/real/) and re-running scripts/training/train_hydrovit.py. The training/eval code now hard-refuses the paired_wq_v5.npz fallback.

key_changes_vs_v8: CNN-ViT hybrid: 3-layer stride-1 CNN (10→32→64→128ch) before ViT
CNNToViTAdapter: fuses raw spectral + CNN features into 13ch ViT input
MultiScaleCNNAggregator: pools all 3 CNN feature maps into 256-dim
DeepWQHeadV2: dual-stream (ViT 256 + CNN 256) with 3 residual blocks
Weighted loss: chl_a=3x, water_temp=3x, turbidity=2x, phycocyanin=2x
120 epochs fine-tune (vs 80 in v8) with cosine annealing
Best model saved by mean R² across all params (not just water_temp)
